title: Dead vs. living wood — cut/leave decision

common.applies_to: Established bush rose; dormant pruning, or the removal-only session of PKR-SGT-000001 v1.1 §2.1

decision_notes.text: Cut a dead cane back into living wood, where the pith is white, not just to where the dead part first shows. One source differs: it says to cut at the point of discoloration.
If the pith is still brown, keep cutting lower in small steps. One source says to remove the whole cane if no live buds remain on it.
